translations.web: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.
translations.bsb: Do we, then, nullify the law by this faith? Certainly not! Instead, we uphold the law.
translations.kjv: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.
translations.asv: Do we then make the law of none effect through faith? God forbid: nay, we establish the law.
